address: 4 Pridiphanomyong 26 Road, Soi Phatthana Wet 3, Khlong Tan Nuea, Vadhana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Set in a quiet alley, Rark offers an intimate kitchen-side experience. In a buzzy yet unpolished, homely setting—wooden walls, open shelving and the sizzle of the wok within earshot—chefs bring finesse to Thai classics. Dishes such as the mix-it-yourself scallop salad or Thai Wagyu with long pepper showcase bold, layered flavours. The à la carte menu reflects a thoughtful, detail-driven style and a deeply personal approach, creating an atmosphere that feels more like dinner at a friend’s home. Booking ahead is advised....
